review_scope.method: Compared every final blind stem, option text, completed passage, and learning-objective metadata against the existing 13-file/346-row historical semantic index and v1 blind packet. Assessed semantic or paraphrase reuse, number-only variants, shared stimulus, and disclosed root/control correlations separately. No private draft, key, label, or lineage/map file was opened; no academic-key adjudication was performed.

correlation_disclosure.note: The paired root/control variants and shared-passage groups are correlated by design. They do not indicate reuse from the 13 historical freezes. Independent source roots should be counted separately from controlled mutations; this review does not characterize all 28 fixtures as independent roots.

freshness_conclusion: No direct semantic/paraphrase reuse or number-only variant of a historical case was found in the exact 13 frozen files represented by the existing index. V2b preserves the v1 stem and option texts, adds source excerpt/metadata, and supplies the four passages that were absent in v1. The completed passages are distinct from historical passages. Reuse of syllabus units or source excerpts is not treated as cloned-question reuse. Within-packet root/control correlations are disclosed above rather than treated as historical freshness blockers.
